properties.strength: Retain temperature, product form, heat treatment and cold-work state.
properties.ductility: Do not infer from nominal alloy chemistry; processing history can dominate.
properties.fracture: Defect population, inclusions, surface condition and environmental exposure may be governing.
properties.functional_materials: Nitinol requires transformation and functional-fatigue characterisation rather than conventional yield-strength-only selection.
properties.high_strength_corrosion_alloys: MP35N selection requires explicit condition and thermomechanical history.
